messages:
miguel: Heads-up — saw repeated KV cache evictions on prod-gpu during last night's nightly-eval. SM% stayed ~60-70% but memory + eviction spikes at ~02:14 UTC. Noticed latency blips too. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/gpu-utilization?panelId=7&orgId=1 :eyes:

nora: saw the same. KV cache hitrate dips and "evictions/sec" panel lines up. Job id was j-20260316-0145 if that helps. KV panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/kvcache?panelId=3

ashley: sre-bot fired an alert around that time: `gpu.kvcache.evictions.rate` high. I muted noisy channel but leaving details here.

sre-bot: ALERT: gpu.kvcache.evictions.rate > 10/s for cluster=prod-gpu (02:14 UTC). AlertID: alert-evict-20260316-0214.

kevin: interesting that SM% isn't maxing — suggests eviction due to transient mem pressure rather than sustained compute load. Do we know batch size distribution for that run? Could be a spike in batch size from the nightly eval config.

miguel: batch size histogram shows a tail up to 32 (normally 16). I can attach histogram if useful. Quick datadog query I ran to look for correlated spikes:

```
avg(last_5m):max:gpu.memory.usage{cluster:prod-gpu} by {host}
```

that shows hosts A,B with short-lived jumps.

nora: +1 on the batch size tail. Nightly eval uses a randomized prompt packing script — might have ended up packing too aggressively. I've opened a ticket to restrict max pack size to 20 for nightly: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3412

kevin: for short-term noise reduction we should tune the eviction alert. Current is >5 evictions/sec sustained 1m. Propose updating to >15 evictions/sec sustained 2m OR add a condition that memory% > 90% when firing. Example alert rule (Datadog metric syntax):

```
avg(last_2m):sum:gpu.kvcache.evictions.rate{cluster:prod-gpu} by {host} > 15 && avg(last_2m):max:gpu.memory.utilization{cluster:prod-gpu} by {host} > 90
```

kevin: I'll open a PR to alerts repo with that change, plus add a runbook link.

miguel: @kevin please also add a link to the grafana panels in the alert so on-call can jump directly.

kevin: will do. PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerts/pull/452 (draft) — PTAL when you have time.

ashley: also can we capture KV eviction traces for one nightly to get context? If we enable trace sampling for j-20260317-eval we can grab the trace ids and correlate to logs. Suggest setting `KV_CACHE_TRACE=1` for one run.

nora: agreed, that'll help. I can flip the flag for tomorrow's run and add a short TTL so it doesn't produce long traces.

miguel: where should folks look for the logs? I pulled the pod logs from Datadog: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=kvcache%20evict%20cluster%3Aprod-gpu — includes eviction messages with trace ids.

kevin: thanks. After PR lands I'll coordinate with @ashley to rollout the alert change to prod. If traces show it's just pack-size regression we revert the alert change and fix the packing script.

miguel: sounds good. tagging for visibility: @kevin @nora @ashley. I'll follow up after tomorrow's run and paste the trace ids here if we get them. :thumbsup:
